diagnostics.message: The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_cloudfront_distribution.default to :resource.aws_s3_bucket.origin duplicates the dependency inferred through local.bucket_domain_name, which is built from local.bucket and aws_s3_bucket.origin.*.id.

The CloudFront distribution should wait for :resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.default so the OAI access policy is attached before the distribution begins serving requests; otherwise initial requests to the private S3 origin can receive access-denied responses. No clean attribute reference to the policy is available here, so use an explicit depends_on.
